
## Mood board fidelity (mandatory)

This app's look and feel is defined by the design mood board at `docs/design/Aero-Kinetic-Design-System.md`, chosen by the repo owner. Implementing it is **not optional**.

- [ ] UI changes follow the mood board (palette, typography, materials, spacing, motion) — or I have justified the adaptation in this PR description.
- [ ] If I touched UI, I verified the result against the mood board in a running build and described how below.
- [ ] I did not remove or weaken the `Mood Board Implementation Directive` (in `AGENTS.md`), the mood board doc, or its `IMPLEMENTATION DIRECTIVE` banner.
